title: Las Vegas Night Tour in Spanish
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Our tour begins at sunset, when the city is dressed in lights and illuminate the Las Vegas Valley. A tour that will make you discover the world capital of entertainment and its casinos.

You will meet the famous “Welcome to Fabulous Las Vegas” sign, a symbol that has been reflected in movies for different decades. Our guide will take the obligatory photo of the group so that you can take it as a souvenir next to the poster.

From here we will start touring the strip and we will visit the architectural wonders of its most relevant mega hotels and casinos including the Luxor Hotel, Bellagio, The Venetian.

 On our tour we will pass by the famous chapels (Wedding Chapels) the famous pawnshop "the Gold and Silver Pawn shop".

We will end the tour in the historic part of the city and visit its most famous street "Fremont Street Experience". Every hour a music video clip takes place on its roof, which is made up of more than 12.5 million LEDs.
